title: Answer: mass is information spinning at the Planck frequency

statements.text: Mass is not fundamental but the informational density of the vacuum spinning at the Planck frequency, so matter is "frozen light". Einstein's $E = mc^2$ is to be replaced by an informational-spin equivalence, $E = I \omega^2$.

sources.quote: We propose that "Mass" is an illusion created by the Informational Density (I) of the vacuum spinning at the Planck Frequency (w).
